title: control-session-inspect reports only presence; also report the grant state and session phase so a host can diagnose a checkpoint refusal
outcome: control-session-inspect reports only presence; also report the grant state and session phase so a host can diagnose a checkpoint refusal
acceptance: `engram control-session-inspect --target-session-id S --retained-grant-id G --json`, still read-only and without reconciling or authorizing, also reports the target session's phase (ready, sync_required or turn_open), whether it holds a begun grant, and the retained grant's state (issued, begun, checkpointed, expired or another stored state) with its session, so a host operator can tell which turn_checkpoint refusal code applies without opening SQLite
A test covers an issued grant, a begun grant in a turn_open session, a checkpointed grant, and an expired grant, and the receipt stays versioned

completion.summary: control-session-inspect now also reports the session phase, begun-grant presence and the retained grant's state, read-only; landed at 5160c093 (ancestor of e7426a6) and verified on the Windows B gate bundle test-fdd408e3. An independent acceptance evaluation passed both criteria (record 9b95f10401224ff18cd75398172cb9ea).
